description:
Farm Steam trading cards, manage achievements, and idle games automatically — an all-in-one alternative to ArchiSteamFarm, Steam Achievement Manager, and Idle Master

Steam Game Idler (SGI) is a Steam automation tool for farming trading cards, managing achievements, and boosting playtime across all games in your Steam library.
## What's Changed
• fix(card-farming)：keep farming through transient badge scrape failures by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2210
• feat(games-list)：add achievement completion sorting by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2211
• feat(sign-in)：rename legacy sign-in to local sign-in by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2212
• build(deps)：bump i18next, zustand, postcss, lint-staged and @types/node by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2214
• build(deps)：bump rustls to 0.23.46 by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2216


**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/compare/6.3.0...6.3.1
